old_caption: The video captures a man engaged in the art of calligraphy. He is positioned on the right side of the frame, facing left, and is wearing glasses and a white shirt with black stripes. The man is holding a large, ornate brush in his right hand, which he uses to write Chinese characters on a white rectangular board mounted on a gray wall. The board features an intricate wooden design on its left edge. As the video progresses, the man meticulously forms each character with deliberate and precise strokes, showcasing his skill and focus. The background includes a section of a white wall and a small circular object, possibly a clock or a decorative item, visible on the upper right corner of the frame. The lighting is consistent throughout the video, highlighting the man's actions and the details of the calligraphy process. There are no significant changes in the environment or the man's position; the focus remains on the act of writing and the evolving artwork on the board.

caption: The video captures a man wearing glasses and a white striped shirt, viewed from behind and to the right, using a brush to write large Chinese characters in black ink on a long horizontal sheet of white paper mounted on a gray textured wall. A carved dark wooden ruler lies vertically along the left edge of the paper, while two small round objects hang on the wall above. The rightmost and middle characters are already fully formed and remain unchanged, while the leftmost character is actively being written. The brush tip stays within the leftmost character's area, progressively depositing new ink strokes, mainly in its lower half, so the glyph grows from a few top strokes into a denser stack of short horizontal strokes. A long bottom horizontal stroke on the leftmost character extends in width across the sequence, with the brush moving along it and an upward tick becoming visible at its left end in later frames. The man's wrist, hand, and forearm shift and rotate modestly as the strokes are laid down, while his head tilts slightly. The background elements remain completely static, with no editing cut or scene change occurring.
